2609.06880.title: Contextual Observer Grounding: Evaluating Situated Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
2609.06880.paper_summary: Reasoning over language instructions in embodied tasks such as robotics often requires understanding spatial relations from a speaker's situated perspective. Humans infer such perspectives from shared environmental knowledge, activity context, and commonsense. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) appear capable of spatial reasoning, but their ability to infer a speaker's viewpoint from contextual cues and interpret situated spatial relations from that viewpoint remains unclear. We call this capability contextual observer grounding. To study this capability, we construct the Point-of-View Benchmark (POVBench), a dataset of 3D scenes and queries that disentangles Inferred, Stated, and Given forms of observer grounding in natural embodied communication. Given multi-view observations and a natural-language sentence, models must localize unseen or underspecified targets from situated spatial and contextual cues. Across state-of-the-art VLMs, localizing targets from directional language remains challenging, even when observer grounding is made explicit. We find that explicit breakdowns of observer-relative spatial reasoning improve target localization. Our project page is available at https://mimo-owl.github.io/POVBench/.
2609.06880.paper_summary_zh: 推理語言指令在具身任務（如機器人技術）中，通常需要從說話者的情境視角理解空間關係。人類從共享的環境知識、活動背景和常識中推斷這些視角。最近的視覺-語言模型（VLMs）似乎具備空間推理的能力，但它們從上下文線索推斷說話者的觀點並從該觀點解釋具體空間關係的能力仍不清楚。我們稱這種能力為情境觀察者基礎。為了研究這種能力，我們構建了視角基準（Point-of-View Benchmark，POVBench），這是一個包含3D場景和查詢的數據集，旨在解開自然具身交流中推斷、陳述和給定形式的觀察者基礎。給定多視角觀察和一個自然語言句子，模型必須從具體的空間和上下文線索中定位未見或未明確的目標。在最先進的VLM中，從方向性語言中定位目標仍然具有挑戰性，即使觀察者基礎被明確指出。我們發現，對觀察者相對空間推理的明確分解能改善目標定位。我們的項目頁面可在 https://mimo-owl.github.io/POVBench/ 查看。
